pair.prefix: Gwent Police said officers went to the High Street in Caerleon, Newport at 22:00 BST on Saturday. The force said there were no injuries and no arrests were made, but it was investigating. A local councillor described it as "horrible spectacle" and has written to police asking for more action. "It's sad to see," said Joan Watkins. "Caerleon is normally a nice, responsible area and I'd like to see businesses open and thriving - but this was an unedifying sight."
